message.content:
VERDICT: do-now
WHY: 29.6.2 fixes five CVEs in BuildKit (command injection via Git checkout, /tmp deletion, destination directory validation bypass, and more), and 29.7.0 fixes CVE-2026-17106 in go-archive, so the notes explicitly flag real security content. Later releases also fix several regressions introduced in 29.7.0 itself (image pull failures on certain images and older kernels), so jumping straight to 29.8.0 avoids landing on a broken intermediate. Nothing in the notes describes a breaking config or API change requiring migration.
WHAT_IT_WILL_TAKE: Nothing beyond the normal update process - a daemon restart, which will briefly stop and recreate running containers. One optional config tweak: if you relied on unlimited concurrent image pulls/pushes, set "max-concurrent-downloads" and "max-concurrent-uploads" to 0 to preserve the old behavior.
message.reasoning: Security fixes in 29.6.2 (multiple CVEs) and 29.7.0 (CVE-2026-17106). Verdict: do-now. No breaking changes noted; one behavior note about concurrent download limits. Docker Engine update requires daemon restart / container recreation.
